fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-06-10, around 10:35, the complainant paid Rs. 4,50,000 as a processing fee for a promised loan that was never disbursed, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-06-11. Contact details given by the complainant, Vasanth Raman, include the number 9000000051. Sathish Sundaram (mobile 9000000372) was named as a possible person of interest. The complaint refers to Udhay Muthu, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000352. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, shopping complex, associate, mobile number, digital document, suspect, morning
